verdict.rationale: Xero offers JAX, an AI feature for plain-language invoicing and reconciliation, plus an official MCP server and AI toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain) enabling natural-language/agentic access to its API. However, these appear limited to specific workflows (invoicing, reconciliation) rather than full natural-language control of the whole product, and no independent/community validation of NL command quality is present.
